meanings.en: a lack of confidence in yourself and your abilities
meanings.exampleEn: Years of criticism filled her with self-doubt.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca süren eleştiri onu kendine güvensizlikle doldurdu.

meanings.en: confidence and satisfaction in oneself
meanings.exampleEn: Doing well at school boosted his self-esteem.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulda başarılı olmak öz saygısını artırdı.

meanings.en: the government of a country or region by its own people
meanings.exampleEn: The colony demanded the right to self-government.
meanings.exampleTr: Sömürge öz yönetim hakkı talep etti.

meanings.en: allowing yourself to have or do things you enjoy, often too much
meanings.exampleEn: It felt self-indulgent to spend the whole day in bed.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün günü yatakta geçirmek kendine düşkünce geldi.

meanings.en: a strong feeling of hatred for yourself
meanings.exampleEn: His failure left him consumed by self-loathing.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısızlığı onu kendinden nefret etme duygusuyla tüketti.

meanings.en: working automatically without human control
meanings.exampleEn: The factory installed a self-operating conveyor system.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika kendiliğinden çalışan bir taşıma bandı sistemi kurdu.

meanings.en: the natural instinct to protect yourself from harm or death
meanings.exampleEn: A sense of self-preservation made her step back from the edge.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini koruma içgüdüsü onu kenardan geri çekilmeye itti.

meanings.en: the act of protecting yourself from harm or danger
meanings.exampleEn: She took a class in self-protection after the incident.
meanings.exampleTr: Olaydan sonra kendini koruma dersi aldı.

meanings.en: controlling your own emotions or behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: He remained calm and self-restrained during the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışma boyunca sakin ve kendini tutan biri olarak kaldı.

meanings.en: able to provide everything you need without help from others
meanings.exampleEn: The village is almost entirely self-sufficient in food.
meanings.exampleTr: Köy gıda konusunda neredeyse tamamen kendine yeter durumda.

meanings.en: to ask or order someone or something to come to you
meanings.exampleEn: When the pain got worse, they sent for a doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağrı kötüleşince bir doktor çağırdılar.

meanings.en: a higher position or rank gained through longer service or age
meanings.exampleEn: Promotions here are usually based on seniority.
meanings.exampleTr: Buradaki terfiler genellikle kıdeme dayanır.

meanings.en: the quality of being easily affected or of understanding others' feelings
meanings.exampleEn: He handled the topic with great sensitivity.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuyu büyük bir duyarlılıkla ele aldı.

meanings.en: the ability of a device to detect small changes
meanings.exampleEn: The sensor's sensitivity allows it to detect tiny movements.
meanings.exampleTr: Sensörün hassasiyeti küçücük hareketleri algılamasını sağlar.

meanings.en: a thing that keeps or sets two or more items apart
meanings.exampleEn: Use a comma as the separator between the values.
meanings.exampleTr: Değerler arasında ayırıcı olarak virgül kullan.

meanings.en: the quality of being serious, important or grave
meanings.exampleEn: They failed to grasp the seriousness of the situation.
meanings.exampleTr: Durumun ciddiyetini kavrayamadılar.

meanings.en: to start living a quiet, stable life in one place
meanings.exampleEn: After years of travelling, they decided to settle down and buy a house.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca seyahat ettikten sonra yerleşip bir ev almaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: to become calm and quiet
meanings.exampleEn: It took a while for the children to settle down.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukların sakinleşmesi biraz zaman aldı.

meanings.en: the way something is organized or arranged
meanings.exampleEn: The new office has a modern open-plan setup.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni ofis modern, açık planlı bir düzene sahip.

meanings.en: a situation arranged to trick or deceive someone
meanings.exampleEn: He claimed the robbery charge was a setup.
meanings.exampleTr: Soygun suçlamasının bir tuzak olduğunu iddia etti.

meanings.en: the number 7
meanings.exampleEn: There are seven days in a week.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir haftada yedi gün vardır.

meanings.en: the number 17
meanings.exampleEn: She turned seventeen last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen hafta on yedi yaşına girdi.

meanings.en: the number 70
meanings.exampleEn: My grandfather is nearly seventy years old.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükbabam neredeyse yetmiş yaşında.

meanings.en: the fact of being very bad, serious or extreme
meanings.exampleEn: The severity of the disease varies from patient to patient.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın şiddeti hastadan hastaya değişir.

meanings.en: having no sex or lacking sexual activity or appeal
meanings.exampleEn: They described their marriage as loving but sexless.
meanings.exampleTr: Evliliklerini sevgi dolu ama cinsellikten yoksun olarak tanımladılar.

meanings.en: the act of forcing unwanted sexual activity on someone
meanings.exampleEn: The charity supports survivors of childhood sexual abuse.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır kurumu çocukluk döneminde cinsel istismara uğrayanları destekliyor.

meanings.en: protected from the sun, giving shade
meanings.exampleEn: We ate lunch under a shady tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğini gölgeli bir ağacın altında yedik.

meanings.en: seeming dishonest or illegal
meanings.exampleEn: He made his money through some shady business deals.
meanings.exampleTr: Parasını birtakım şüpheli iş anlaşmalarıyla kazandı.

meanings.en: used to make offers or suggestions, or to talk about the future
meanings.exampleEn: Shall we go for a walk?
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşe çıkalım mı?

meanings.en: behaving in a bad way without feeling ashamed
meanings.exampleEn: It was a shameless attempt to grab attention.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, dikkat çekmek için utanmaz bir girişimdi.

meanings.en: an area of a town where poor people live in makeshift huts
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands live in the shantytown on the edge of the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce kişi şehrin kenarındaki gecekondu mahallesinde yaşıyor.

meanings.en: the market where company shares are bought and sold
meanings.exampleEn: Prices on the share market fell sharply today.
meanings.exampleTr: Bugün borsadaki fiyatlar keskin bir şekilde düştü.

meanings.en: used to refer to a female person or animal mentioned before
meanings.exampleEn: My sister called and she sounded happy.
meanings.exampleTr: Kız kardeşim aradı ve mutlu görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a soft, smooth shine on a surface
meanings.exampleEn: Her hair had a healthy sheen.
meanings.exampleTr: Saçlarında sağlıklı bir parlaklık vardı.

meanings.en: a load of goods sent together, or the act of sending them
meanings.exampleEn: The latest shipment of goods arrived at the port yesterday.
meanings.exampleTr: Son mal sevkiyatı dün limana ulaştı.

meanings.en: the quality of being badly made or done
meanings.exampleEn: Customers complained about the shoddiness of the workmanship.
meanings.exampleTr: Müşteriler işçiliğin özensizliğinden şikâyet etti.

meanings.en: unable to see distant things clearly
meanings.exampleEn: She is short-sighted and needs glasses to drive.
meanings.exampleTr: Miyop ve araba kullanmak için gözlüğe ihtiyacı var.

meanings.en: not considering the future effects of an action
meanings.exampleEn: Cutting the training budget was a short-sighted decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Eğitim bütçesini kesmek ileri görüşten yoksun bir karardı.

meanings.en: a quicker route or a faster way of doing something
meanings.exampleEn: We took a shortcut through the park to save time.
meanings.exampleTr: Zaman kazanmak için parktan bir kestirme yol kullandık.

meanings.en: used to say what is the right or best thing to do
meanings.exampleEn: You should see a doctor about that cough.
meanings.exampleTr: O öksürük için bir doktora görünmelisin.

meanings.tr: hava atma, gösteriş yapma, caka satma
meanings.en: behaving so as to attract admiration for yourself
meanings.exampleEn: He kept showing off his new car to the neighbours.
meanings.exampleTr: Komşulara sürekli yeni arabasıyla hava atıyordu.

meanings.en: attracting attention by being bright, large or expensive
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a showy diamond necklace to the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiye gösterişli bir elmas kolye takıp gitti.

meanings.en: having good judgement, especially about money or people
meanings.exampleEn: She is a shrewd businesswoman who rarely loses money.
meanings.exampleTr: Nadiren para kaybeden işbilir bir iş kadınıdır.

meanings.en: in a way that shows good judgement
meanings.exampleEn: He shrewdly invested his savings in property.
meanings.exampleTr: Birikimlerini akıllıca gayrimenkule yatırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of having good judgement and being clever
meanings.exampleEn: Her business shrewdness turned a small shop into a chain.
meanings.exampleTr: İş konusundaki işbilirliği küçük bir dükkânı zincire dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: the process of becoming smaller, or loss of stock through theft or damage
meanings.exampleEn: The label warns of possible shrinkage after washing.
meanings.exampleTr: Etiket, yıkamadan sonra olası büzülme konusunda uyarıyor.

meanings.en: the process of drying up and wrinkling or becoming smaller
meanings.exampleEn: The heat caused the shrivelling of the leaves.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak, yaprakların kuruyup büzülmesine neden oldu.

meanings.en: a cloth used to wrap a dead body, or something that hides
meanings.exampleEn: The body was wrapped in a white shroud.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceset beyaz bir kefene sarılmıştı.

meanings.en: to cover or hide something
meanings.exampleEn: Mist shrouded the mountains at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Şafakta sis dağları örttü.

meanings.en: to deliberately avoid someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: After the scandal, his former friends began to shun him.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandaldan sonra eski dostları ondan uzak durmaya başladı.
